scheme_name: International Cooperation Scheme- Market Development Assistance
other_conditions: The applicant organization must be the Ministry of MSME, an organization under the Ministry, a State/Central Government organisation/institution, or a registered industry/enterprise association.
The applicant organization must be duly registered under the relevant Act (e.g., Companies Act, Societies Act) with the primary objective of promotion and development of MSMEs.
The applicant organization must have regular audited accounts for the past three years.
Events for which financial support is sought must be from the list of approved exhibitions/events/buyer‑seller meets finalized by the Ministry of MSME each financial year.
Financial assistance is normally limited to three events per applicant organization in a financial year, subject to possible relaxation by the Screening Committee.
Industry associations/organizations may participate in a particular event continuously for three years, after which a two‑year gap is required before further participation in the same event.
An MSME unit may not participate in more than two events in a financial year under the scheme.
Selection of participating MSME units is based on a scorecard with a minimum qualifying score of 60 %.
Adequate representation must be given to SC, ST, women and NER entrepreneurs, with priority to those who have not previously received a government grant for such events.
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement‑based financial assistance for expenses such as airfare, stall rent, freight, advertising, registration fees, and organization of international conferences and seminars.
documents_required: Audited accounts for the past three years
